trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missable_reason: Combat Focus can be used any time in free-roam (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is activated with L3 plus R3 while aiming a firearm; it slows time, highlights vulnerable spots and drains the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first with food and drinks or by washing your face and showering at home, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press triangle) to extend it. Line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations work well — and defeat them quickly; an assault rifle such as the Duke 556 is more accurate than pistols or SMGs. Per PowerPyx it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting-range challenges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots (PowerPyx).

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missable_reason: Armored trucks keep driving around Vice City in free-roam (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: This unlocks automatically in the same Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing the vault of a large bank counts as robbing an armored truck — tail the truck to the bank, enter the vault, steal the cash and escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray. An earlier method: block an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missable_reason: The showroom and the car stay available in free-roam (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Steal the specific blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom located in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal this car after obtaining the Key Cloner during the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy). The trophy unlocks with a slight delay after driving away, and only this specific blue Banshee counts as an easter egg reference to GTA III (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missable_reason: Not missable: if you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns later and you can return for the rest (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, which is one of the gang operations. Purchase sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation beforehand to blow open the safe. The items include a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. You visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and the trophy unlocks after escaping the police once all items are collected across visits if necessary (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missable_reason: Working out stays available in free-roam with both characters (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia simultaneously. This can be started after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break when character switching becomes available. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, and then Strength (heart icon). Increase strength by working out at fitness clubs (filtered on the Map under Activities); buy a membership and call your partner by holding right and pressing triangle so while one trains, the other completes training automatically to progress twice as fast (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_reason: Profile actions accumulate through normal play and stay farmable in free-roam (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your criminal profile, and check your count by clicking the trophy in the list. Enable criminal profile notifications in Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, and Criminal Profile so a small demon face appears when an action counts. Profiles include Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, and Irredeemable (which makes police extremely aggressive, so avoid it). Most actions accrue naturally from robberies and free-roam encounters (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_reason: The easter egg can be attempted repeatedly in free-roam; the spawn is random, not one-time (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg on the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, alone at night after 2AM. The spawn is random: look for a blinking car at the roadside (if absent, drive away and return). Follow the path into the woods next to the car to spot the UFO (a bright blue light), approach it as it drops an abducted woman, talk to her, offer to help, and return to her car at the roadside (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missable_reason: Laundering stays available in free-roam; the total counts across all robberies (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then deliver marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays best). The $250,000 total accumulates across all deliveries and comes naturally from robberies, with bank vaults paying up to $205,000 each (PowerPyx).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missable_reason: Registration stays available in free-roam once unlocked (PowerPyx).
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles using the Scooter Bros app installed after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You must purchase enough garages first to provide parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn to choose Respray and Register; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Using cheap low-end cars and bikes minimizes registration costs (PowerPyx).
